Title: Traffic Manager support for external endpoints

Body.Content: Traffic Manager supports Azure endpoints and external endpoints, so you can control the distribution of user traffic to the endpoints you choose. Build highly available applications across Azure and on-premises, and apply intelligent traffic management policies across endpoints that live outside of Azure. For more information, visit the Traffic Manager page. To get a comprehensive look at pricing, visit the Traffic Manager Pricing Details page.
Body.Markdown:
Traffic Manager supports Azure endpoints and external endpoints, so you can control the distribution of user traffic to the endpoints you choose.
